name: US EPA and Environment and Climate Change Canada
description: US EPA and Environment and Climate Change Canada set methane, air, water and greenhouse-gas requirements for operations. The immediate issue is methane detection, flaring, reporting, state plans and facility performance. Its decisions or actions can require capital upgrades, penalties or operating changes.
urgency_rationale: Methane rules and reporting affect current operating practices and economics.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations

🔎 EPA methane rule: EPA’s final rule establishes standards and state-plan procedures for methane emissions. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations/epas-final-rule-reduce-methane-and-other
🔎 Canada Energy Regulator: CER regulates federally governed pipelines and power lines in Canada. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/index-eng.html
alternate_rationale: Keep Satisfied may fit best-in-class assets; implementation and enforcement require close engagement.

engagement_tactics.label: Create a single evidence room and joint workplan with US EPA and Environment and Climate Change Canada
engagement_tactics.rationale: Gives the authority traceable data, named owners and early visibility of corrective action.

engagement_tactics.label: Rely mainly on trade-association lobbying
engagement_tactics.rationale: Collective advocacy cannot substitute for company-specific compliance evidence.

engagement_tactics.label: Wait for a notice, inspection or deficiency letter
engagement_tactics.rationale: Reactive engagement reduces room to correct problems before enforcement.

name: Indigenous Nations and Tribal Governments
description: Indigenous Nations and Tribal Governments hold rights, knowledge and governance interests across many project areas. The immediate issue is early consultation, cultural sites, cumulative impacts, monitoring and benefit sharing. Its decisions or actions can reshape routes, challenge approvals or become long-term project partners.
urgency_rationale: Rights and land concerns must influence design before commitments are locked.
intel_dossier: 🔎 CER Indigenous engagement: CER describes engagement expectations for energy projects affecting Indigenous Peoples. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/consultation-engagement/land-matters-guide/brochures/cer-energy-projects-indigenous-peoples/
🔎 Canada Energy Regulator: CER regulates federally governed pipelines and power lines in Canada. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/index-eng.html

🔎 CER pipeline regulation: CER explains federal jurisdiction and responsibilities for interprovincial and international pipelines. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/about/who-we-are-what-we-do/pipeline-regulation-in-canada.html
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed is insufficient where rights may be affected; it fits only distant, low-impact interests.

engagement_tactics.label: Use rights-based, early and continuous engagement with Indigenous Nations and Tribal Governments
engagement_tactics.rationale: Respects legal and cultural standing while allowing project design to change before lock-in.

engagement_tactics.label: Treat consultation as a one-time permitting formality
engagement_tactics.rationale: Late transactional contact increases legal, schedule and relationship risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Offer benefits without discussing land, rights and monitoring
engagement_tactics.rationale: Economic offers do not replace consent, impact assessment or stewardship concerns.

name: Landowners, Ranchers and Local Communities
description: Landowners, Ranchers and Local Communities provide access and bear safety, noise, traffic, water and property impacts. The immediate issue is easements, restoration, emergency planning, methane and complaint response. Its decisions or actions can delay access, litigate or mobilise local government.
urgency_rationale: Local access and trust can become the critical path for wells and pipelines.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations

🔎 CER pipeline regulation: CER explains federal jurisdiction and responsibilities for interprovincial and international pipelines. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/about/who-we-are-what-we-do/pipeline-regulation-in-canada.html
🔎 US Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration: PHMSA regulates pipeline and hazardous-material safety. | https://www.phmsa.dot.gov/
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed may fit stable legacy assets; new construction requires close partnership.

engagement_tactics.label: Create a representative forum with independent data review for Landowners, Ranchers and Local Communities
engagement_tactics.rationale: Combines voice, verifiable evidence and a public commitments tracker.

engagement_tactics.label: Replace consultation with local donations
engagement_tactics.rationale: Philanthropy does not address rights, exposure or operational impacts.

engagement_tactics.label: Engage only through local political intermediaries
engagement_tactics.rationale: Excludes affected groups and makes consent appear managed rather than earned.

name: Employees, Contractors and Unions
description: Employees, Contractors and Unions operate wells, plants, pipelines, refineries and emergency systems. The immediate issue is process safety, competence, fatigue, contractor control and stop-work authority. Its decisions or actions can prevent or cause major incidents and prolonged outages.
urgency_rationale: Front-line decisions are critical in high-energy operations.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration: PHMSA regulates pipeline and hazardous-material safety. | https://www.phmsa.dot.gov/
🔎 US offshore energy safety: BSEE regulates safety and environmental enforcement for US offshore energy operations. | https://www.bsee.gov/
🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed fits low-risk support staff, not operating and maintenance teams.

engagement_tactics.label: Negotiate a safety, skills and workload plan with Employees, Contractors and Unions
engagement_tactics.rationale: Uses formal worker voice and measurable actions to reduce operational and labour risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Use attendance bonuses to suppress grievances
engagement_tactics.rationale: Treats symptoms, discourages reporting and can worsen fatigue-related risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Communicate only through line supervisors
engagement_tactics.rationale: Workers need trusted escalation channels and protection from retaliation.

name: Utilities, Refineries, LNG Buyers and Industrial Offtakers
description: Utilities, Refineries, LNG Buyers and Industrial Offtakers anchor revenue and require reliability, quality, flexibility and emissions information. The immediate issue is contract performance, capacity, methane intensity and force majeure. Its decisions or actions can redirect supply, renegotiate price or impair asset utilisation.
urgency_rationale: Daily nominations and long-term contracts directly affect cash flow.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations

🔎 EPA methane rule: EPA’s final rule establishes standards and state-plan procedures for methane emissions. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations/epas-final-rule-reduce-methane-and-other

🔎 CER pipeline regulation: CER explains federal jurisdiction and responsibilities for interprovincial and international pipelines. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/about/who-we-are-what-we-do/pipeline-regulation-in-canada.html
alternate_rationale: Keep Satisfied fits diversified short-term sales; anchor customers require close coordination.

engagement_tactics.label: Build a joint service, quality and continuity plan with Utilities, Refineries, LNG Buyers and Industrial Offtakers
engagement_tactics.rationale: Makes performance expectations explicit and creates early-warning triggers.

engagement_tactics.label: Promise priority supply to every major account
engagement_tactics.rationale: Conflicting commitments become impossible to honour during a disruption.

engagement_tactics.label: Limit contact to sales teams
engagement_tactics.rationale: Commercial dialogue alone misses quality, safety and operational dependencies.

name: Banks, Insurers, Pension Funds and Shareholders
description: Banks, Insurers, Pension Funds and Shareholders price commodity, litigation, methane, reserve and transition risk. The immediate issue is capital returns, liability, decommissioning and regulatory compliance. Its decisions or actions can raise funding costs, restrict insurance or press for portfolio change.
urgency_rationale: Material incidents and regulation can reprice long-lived assets quickly.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations
🔎 Canada Energy Regulator: CER regulates federally governed pipelines and power lines in Canada. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/index-eng.html
🔎 US offshore energy safety: BSEE regulates safety and environmental enforcement for US offshore energy operations. | https://www.bsee.gov/
alternate_rationale: Manage Closely applies for project finance, M&A, activism or major incidents.

engagement_tactics.label: Brief Banks, Insurers, Pension Funds and Shareholders on material risks, capital needs, milestones and downside cases
engagement_tactics.rationale: Allows investors to test execution quality rather than rely on broad commitments.

engagement_tactics.label: Describe the exposure as immaterial until a charge is booked
engagement_tactics.rationale: Delayed disclosure increases surprise and credibility risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Promise a fixed outcome that management cannot control
engagement_tactics.rationale: Overconfidence creates litigation and trust risk if regulation or markets change.

name: Climate, Conservation and Community NGOs
description: Climate, Conservation and Community NGOs shape permitting, litigation, investor pressure and public narratives. The immediate issue is methane, spills, Indigenous rights, new infrastructure and restoration. Its decisions or actions can delay projects or intensify scrutiny across jurisdictions.
urgency_rationale: Campaigns can connect satellite or public data to legal and financial action.
intel_dossier: 🔎 EPA methane rule: EPA’s final rule establishes standards and state-plan procedures for methane emissions. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations/epas-final-rule-reduce-methane-and-other

🔎 CER Indigenous engagement: CER describes engagement expectations for energy projects affecting Indigenous Peoples. | https://www.cer-rec.gc.ca/en/consultation-engagement/land-matters-guide/brochures/cer-energy-projects-indigenous-peoples/
🔎 US offshore leasing and resources: BOEM manages offshore energy and mineral resources. | https://www.boem.gov/
alternate_rationale: Manage Closely is appropriate for contested projects and live litigation.

engagement_tactics.label: Provide evidence, site access and independent verification to Climate, Conservation and Community NGOs
engagement_tactics.rationale: Credible transparency can narrow disagreement and expose fixable gaps.

engagement_tactics.label: Threaten litigation at the first criticism
engagement_tactics.rationale: An aggressive opening can amplify the issue and deter legitimate dialogue.

engagement_tactics.label: Pay for favourable third-party content
engagement_tactics.rationale: Perceived astroturfing damages trust if uncovered.

name: Drilling, Midstream, EPC and Emergency-Response Contractors
description: Drilling, Midstream, EPC and Emergency-Response Contractors deliver safety-critical construction, operations and incident response. The immediate issue is competence, equipment integrity, interface control and mobilisation capacity. Its decisions or actions can cause schedule, safety or environmental failure.
urgency_rationale: Contractors perform a large share of high-risk work and can transmit systemic risk.
intel_dossier: 🔎 US Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration: PHMSA regulates pipeline and hazardous-material safety. | https://www.phmsa.dot.gov/
🔎 US offshore energy safety: BSEE regulates safety and environmental enforcement for US offshore energy operations. | https://www.bsee.gov/
🔎 US EPA oil and gas air rules: EPA regulates methane and other air pollution from oil and natural-gas operations. | https://www.epa.gov/controlling-air-pollution-oil-and-natural-gas-operations
alternate_rationale: Keep Informed fits routine low-risk services; safety-critical work needs integrated management.

engagement_tactics.label: Segment critical suppliers and fund traceability plus remediation with Drilling, Midstream, EPC and Emergency-Response Contractors
engagement_tactics.rationale: Protects continuity while addressing root causes rather than shifting them down-tier.

engagement_tactics.label: Terminate every non-conforming supplier immediately
engagement_tactics.rationale: Abrupt exits can deepen shortages and hide problems in less visible tiers.

engagement_tactics.label: Accept annual self-certification as sufficient
engagement_tactics.rationale: High-risk supply chains require evidence, audit and corrective-action closure.
